[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Shifting String** [CF 1690F · Shifting String](https://codeforces.com/problemset/problem/1690/F){rating="1700"}

Applying $p$ only moves letters around inside each cycle of $p$, so every cycle is an independent ring of letters being rotated one step per operation. A ring of length $L$ returns to its start after $d$ steps, where $d$ is the smallest period of its letter sequence ($d \mid L$). The whole string returns when every ring does: $k = \operatorname{lcm}$ of the periods.

[Solved in full in @sec-idx-p5-shift.]{.card-link}
